title: Champion of MIndSpark-24 (project showcase)
description:
🏆 Champion – MindSpark'24 Project Showcase

Secured 1st Place in the MindSpark'24 Project Showcase, competing against 25 teams. Our project was recognized for its innovation, technical implementation, and practical impact, demonstrating strong teamwork, problem-solving, and software development skills.

title: 5th international robo tech olympiad
description: Awarded 2nd Runner-Up in the Project Showcase (Senior Category) at the 5th International Robo Tech Olympiad 2025 for developing an innovative project and successfully competing against teams from multiple institutions.

title: Brainstorming Week: Microcontroller Hardware Project Champion
description:
Brainstorming Week – Microcontroller Hardware Project Champion
Won Champion in the Microcontroller & IoT-Based Hardware Research Project organized by the Department of CSE, BUBT. Developed the Mission Control System, demonstrating innovation in embedded systems, IoT integration, and collaborative engineering.

title: NRC 3rd Runners-up ,2025
description:
🏆 NRC 2025 – 3rd Runners-up
Secured 3rd Runners-up at the National Robotics Championship (NRC) 2025, competing against skilled teams nationwide. Collaborated to develop and present an innovative engineering solution, demonstrating technical expertise, teamwork, and creative problem-solving.
